thread:
Lydia (Leadership): Quick follow-up from today's security segment — can we confirm timelines + owners for SOC2, ISO, KMS BYOK/HSM, VPC PrivateLink, and audit log retention/export? Customers are asking for specifics. I'll capture answers here. :raised_hands:

Asha (Security): Short answers would be great. For SOC2: are we pursuing Type I or Type II, and which products (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) are in-scope?

Lydia (Leadership): We're aiming for SOC2 Type II. Scope: Hosted + Dedicated first; Private deployments will have a narrower, documented scope since infra is customer-managed. Tentative audit readiness window: Q3, with Type II completion targeted by end of Q4 2025. Owner: Priya.

Priya (Compliance): Confirming ownership. I'll publish a controls mapping + evidence checklist next week. For Private we will provide a "controls playbook" customers can use to collect evidence.

Ben (Infra): For VPC / PrivateLink: control-plane private connectivity is in the next sprint. ETA for PrivateLink peering + docs: mid-Q3. We'll also add an option to mirror audit logs (stream) into a customer-owned destination (S3/GS/ObjStore).

Tom (SRE): Quick clarifying Q: what's the default audit log retention on Hosted today — 90 days or 365? Need to answer customers.

Priya (Compliance): Hosted default = 90 days for most logs. 365-day retention will be offered as an enterprise add-on with export to customer bucket. We'll add retention options to the console and call them out in the SLA addendum.

Asha (Security): KMS BYOK timeline — customers specifically want HSM-backed keys and a clear rotation policy. Any dates?

Lydia (Leadership): BYOK (customer-managed keys) support: alpha for Dedicated in Q2, GA across Dedicated + Hosted (HSM integration included) by Q4. Rotation: we'll support both automated rotation and manual rotation workflows. Owners: Ben + Asha (Security Eng).

security-bot: SOC2 roadmap doc added: https://internal.redwood/compliance/soc2-roadmap (permissions may be required).

Ben (Infra): Example audit-export snippet we'll wire into Console as a template:
```yaml
audit_export:
  destination: s3://my-company-redwood-logs
  format: jsonl
  retention_days: 365
```

Tom (SRE): Flag for legal / ops: eDiscovery and immutable snapshots — do we offer snapshots for legal holds? Need an internal process documented.

Priya (Compliance): We'll produce an eDiscovery playbook. Action items (high level):
1) Priya to publish evidence checklist by 2025-03-15.
2) Ben to ship audit export UI & template by 2025-06-01.
3) Asha to run KMS BYOK alpha on staging by 2025-05-20.
4) Team to hold office hours next Wed 10am PT for deeper Q&A.

Lydia (Leadership): Thanks — I'll share this summary with customer success and partner teams. @Ben @Priya please confirm/cancel the dates if they don't work. :thumbsup: 

Ben (Infra): Confirmed, adding to calendar now. :calendar: 

Tom (SRE): I'll draft a short FAQ blurb for support to use — will post here for edits.

Asha (Security): I'll be at the office hours and can run through BYOK slides. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: New doc created: compliance/summaries/soc2-kms-vpc-followup-2432109876.md

Lydia (Leadership): Closing the thread for now — if anything else comes up before office hours, reply here and we'll append to the agenda. Thanks everyone.
